token_provenance.canvas: brand_extract.py on https://pliny.gg (creator's own site; T3MP3ST has no dedicated project site) -- frequency heuristic, darkest common, confidence medium
token_provenance.ink: brand_extract.py on pliny.gg -- frequency heuristic, lightest common, confidence medium
token_provenance.accent: brand_extract.py on pliny.gg extracted an author-declared css var --accent as #f80f0f (601-luma ~85), then LIGHTENED to #ff7a61 (same hue, 601-luma ~159) after the screening gate FAILed readability on the flash scene -- the flash template fills the full-bleed background with the raw accent and puts canvas-colored text on top (an inverted/light-polarity beat by design), so the accent itself has to actually BE bright. #f80f0f was too dark to read as a light field, same failure class as the 2026-07-04c mcp-use entry (accent luma 115.7, lightened to 156.4) and the 2026-07-04 caveman entry. Fixed at the token, not the renderer, preserving hue.
token_provenance.attempt_log: tried github.com/elder-plinius/T3MP3ST first (exit 3, insufficient signal, no colors found -- GitHub's own chrome carries no project-declared theme); fell back to the creator's owned site pliny.gg per step 6.2, which returned confidence medium with an author-declared accent var. Judged against the site by eye: near-black canvas with hot alarm-red is authentically the persona's look, not a generic dark preset.

readability_plan.ink_floor: dark canvas, primary ink >= 230 luma (#fff1e5 measures ~244, clears with margin)
readability_plan.accent_as_graphic: raw #ff7a61 (luma ~159, lightened post-gate-fail) carries the diagram's lit recon node, dots, glows, and the flash scene's full-bleed field; any OTHER text-scale accent use relies on build_html's auto-derived --accent-ink
readability_plan.muted_carries_content: diagram node labels and mono_block status lines use --muted-content, not raw --ink-muted
readability_plan.light_per_scene: wire_dispatch: ticker+headline at full ink brightness, dateline in muted-content. diagram: recon node glows accent, other node labels in muted-content -- the honesty-of-maturity visual. terminal: prompt lines bright ink/accent-ink in a widened pane. mono_block: status lines in ink, the recon line lifted to accent-ink. flash: full-bleed accent field is the one inverted/bright beat. sparkline: curve in raw accent, value label in accent-ink. logo_reveal: bright ink wordmark + sheen, tagline in muted-content.
readability_plan.inverted_beat: flash (scene 5 of 7) is the color-break: accent field burst instead of dark canvas
